(** GENERATED FILE — proof obligations for [release].

    Source contract: examples.inventory.contract:release_contract
    Generator: specsaver.lower (v2).  Do not edit by hand.

    Shape: multi-delta over keyed rows, N exception arms, typed fields.
    Deferred (v2, trace emission): state.gauge_log, state.release_log *)

From iris.proofmode Require Import proofmode.
From iris.base_logic.lib Require Import gen_heap.
Require Import AxiomanderLang AxiomanderWp.
Require Import AxiomanderPrelude.

Section gen_release.
Context `{FC : FunCtx}.

Definition store_loc : loc := Loc 1%positive.
Definition trace_loc : loc := Loc 2%positive.


Definition row_of (on_hand reserved reorder_point : Z) : sn_val :=
  LitDict [(LitString "on_hand", LitInt on_hand);
           (LitString "reserved", LitInt reserved);
           (LitString "reorder_point", LitInt reorder_point)].

Definition row_inv (v : sn_val) : Prop :=
  exists on_hand reserved reorder_point,
    v = (row_of (on_hand) (reserved) (reorder_point)) /\ (on_hand >= 0)%Z /\ (reserved >= 0)%Z /\ (reserved <= on_hand)%Z.

Fixpoint store_inv (kvs : list (sn_val * sn_val)) : Prop :=
  match kvs with
  | [] => True
  | (_, v) :: rest => row_inv v /\ store_inv rest
  end.

Definition gen_pre (sigma : sn_state) (vs : list sn_val) : Prop :=
  exists sku order quantity store_d on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku,
    vs = [LitString sku; LitString order; LitInt quantity] /\
    sigma !! store_loc = Some (LitDict store_d) /\
    dict_lookup_str sku store_d = Some (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku)) /\
    (quantity > 0)%Z /\ (((reserved_sku >= quantity)%Z)).

Definition gen_post (sigma : sn_state) (vs : list sn_val)
    (r : Result) (ups : cell_updates) : Prop :=
  exists sku order quantity store_d on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku,
    vs = [LitString sku; LitString order; LitInt quantity] /\
    sigma !! store_loc = Some (LitDict store_d) /\
    dict_lookup_str sku store_d = Some (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku)) /\
    r = RVal (LitInt reserved_sku) /\
    ups = [(store_loc, LitDict (dict_insert_str sku (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku - quantity) (reorder_point_sku)) store_d))].

Definition gen_exc0_pre (sigma : sn_state) (vs : list sn_val) : Prop :=
  exists sku order quantity store_d on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku,
    vs = [LitString sku; LitString order; LitInt quantity] /\
    sigma !! store_loc = Some (LitDict store_d) /\
    dict_lookup_str sku store_d = Some (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku)) /\
    (reserved_sku < quantity)%Z.

Definition gen_exc0_post (sigma : sn_state) (vs : list sn_val)
    (r : Result) (ups : cell_updates) : Prop :=
  exists sku order quantity store_d on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku,
    vs = [LitString sku; LitString order; LitInt quantity] /\
    sigma !! store_loc = Some (LitDict store_d) /\
    dict_lookup_str sku store_d = Some (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku)) /\
    r = RExn "ReleaseExceedsReservedError" (LitTuple [LitInt reserved_sku; LitString sku; LitString order; LitInt quantity]) /\ ups = [].

Definition gen_table (f : string) : option fun_entry :=
  if String.eqb f "release" then Some (FunSpecS gen_pre gen_post)
  else if String.eqb f "release_exc0" then
  Some (FunSpecS gen_exc0_pre gen_exc0_post)
  else None.

Lemma gen_table_total_pure : forall f pre post vs,
  gen_table f = Some (FunSpec pre post) ->
  pre vs -> exists v, post vs v.
Proof.
  intros f pre post vs Hgen Hpre.
  unfold gen_table in Hgen.
  destruct (String.eqb f "release") eqn:Erel.
  - discriminate.
  - destruct (String.eqb f "release_exc0") eqn:Eexc.
    + discriminate.
    + discriminate.

  { (* gen_table_total_pure:unknown *) admit. }
Admitted.

Lemma gen_table_total : forall f pre post vs sigma,
  gen_table f = Some (FunSpecS pre post) ->
  pre sigma vs ->
  exists r ups, post sigma vs r ups /\ updates_dom_in sigma ups.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma gen_preserves_inv_0 : forall sku quantity store_d on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku,
  dict_lookup_str sku store_d = Some (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku)) ->
  row_inv (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku)) ->
  (quantity > 0)%Z ->
  (reserved_sku - quantity >= 0)%Z ->
  store_inv store_d ->
  store_inv (dict_insert_str sku (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku - quantity) (reorder_point_sku)) store_d).
Proof.
Admitted.

#[global] Instance gen_fun_ctx : FunCtx :=
  {| fun_entries := gen_table;
     fun_specs_total := gen_table_total_pure;
     fun_specsS_total := gen_table_total |}.

Lemma store_inv_lookup : forall store_d k row,
  store_inv store_d ->
  dict_lookup_str k store_d = Some row ->
  row_inv row.
Proof.
Admitted.

(** O1: admissibility sanity — some state and args satisfy pre ∧ invariant. *)
Lemma o1_admissibility_sanity :
  exists sigma vs, gen_pre sigma vs /\ store_inv [(LitString "SKU1", (row_of (100) (10) (10)))].
Proof.
Admitted.

(** O2: spec consistency — totality gives a post-satisfying outcome. *)
Lemma o2_spec_consistency : forall sigma vs,
  gen_pre sigma vs ->
  exists r ups, gen_post sigma vs r ups /\ updates_dom_in sigma ups.
Proof.
Admitted.

(** O3.0: exception consistency — the ReleaseExceedsReservedError arm is satisfiable. *)
Lemma o3_0_exception_consistency : forall sigma vs,
  gen_exc0_pre sigma vs ->
  exists r ups, gen_exc0_post sigma vs r ups /\ updates_dom_in sigma ups.
Proof.
Admitted.

(** O4: exit coverage — availability and the exit conditions partition. *)
Lemma o4_exit_coverage : forall (on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku quantity : Z) ( sku : string),
  (((reserved_sku >= quantity)%Z)) \/ (((reserved_sku < quantity)%Z)).
Proof. intros. lia. Admitted.

(** O5: invariant preservation across the nested delta updates. *)
Lemma o5_invariant_preservation : forall (sku order : string) (quantity : Z) (store_d : list (sn_val * sn_val)) (on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku : Z),
  ((quantity > 0)%Z) ->
  (((reserved_sku >= quantity)%Z)) ->
  dict_lookup_str sku store_d = Some (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku)) ->
  store_inv store_d ->
  store_inv (dict_insert_str sku (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku - quantity) (reorder_point_sku)) store_d).
Proof.
Admitted.

(** O8: frame soundness — everything outside the declared frame is
    unchanged.  The generated footprint is the single store cell; every
    other location (including the trace cell) is preserved. *)
Lemma o8_frame_soundness : forall sigma vs r ups,
  gen_post sigma vs r ups ->
  forall l, l <> store_loc ->
    (apply_updates sigma ups) !! l = sigma !! l.
Proof.
Admitted.

End gen_release.

(** GENERATED FILE — proof obligations for [release].

    Source contract: examples.inventory.contract:release_contract
    Generator: specsaver.lower (v2).  Do not edit by hand.

    Shape: multi-delta over keyed rows, N exception arms, typed fields.
    Deferred (v2, trace emission): state.gauge_log, state.release_log *)

From iris.proofmode Require Import proofmode.
From iris.base_logic.lib Require Import gen_heap.
Require Import AxiomanderLang AxiomanderWp.
Require Import AxiomanderPrelude.

Section gen_release.
Context `{FC : FunCtx}.

Definition store_loc : loc := Loc 1%positive.
Definition trace_loc : loc := Loc 2%positive.


Definition row_of (on_hand reserved reorder_point : Z) : sn_val :=
  LitDict [(LitString "on_hand", LitInt on_hand);
           (LitString "reserved", LitInt reserved);
           (LitString "reorder_point", LitInt reorder_point)].

Definition row_inv (v : sn_val) : Prop :=
  exists on_hand reserved reorder_point,
    v = (row_of (on_hand) (reserved) (reorder_point)) /\ (on_hand >= 0)%Z /\ (reserved >= 0)%Z /\ (reserved <= on_hand)%Z.

Fixpoint store_inv (kvs : list (sn_val * sn_val)) : Prop :=
  match kvs with
  | [] => True
  | (_, v) :: rest => row_inv v /\ store_inv rest
  end.

Definition gen_pre (sigma : sn_state) (vs : list sn_val) : Prop :=
  exists sku order quantity store_d on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku,
    vs = [LitString sku; LitString order; LitInt quantity] /\
    sigma !! store_loc = Some (LitDict store_d) /\
    dict_lookup_str sku store_d = Some (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku)) /\
    (quantity > 0)%Z /\ (((reserved_sku >= quantity)%Z)).

Definition gen_post (sigma : sn_state) (vs : list sn_val)
    (r : Result) (ups : cell_updates) : Prop :=
  exists sku order quantity store_d on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku,
    vs = [LitString sku; LitString order; LitInt quantity] /\
    sigma !! store_loc = Some (LitDict store_d) /\
    dict_lookup_str sku store_d = Some (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku)) /\
    r = RVal (LitInt reserved_sku) /\
    ups = [(store_loc, LitDict (dict_insert_str sku (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku - quantity) (reorder_point_sku)) store_d))].

Definition gen_exc0_pre (sigma : sn_state) (vs : list sn_val) : Prop :=
  exists sku order quantity store_d on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku,
    vs = [LitString sku; LitString order; LitInt quantity] /\
    sigma !! store_loc = Some (LitDict store_d) /\
    dict_lookup_str sku store_d = Some (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku)) /\
    (reserved_sku < quantity)%Z.

Definition gen_exc0_post (sigma : sn_state) (vs : list sn_val)
    (r : Result) (ups : cell_updates) : Prop :=
  exists sku order quantity store_d on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku,
    vs = [LitString sku; LitString order; LitInt quantity] /\
    sigma !! store_loc = Some (LitDict store_d) /\
    dict_lookup_str sku store_d = Some (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku)) /\
    r = RExn "ReleaseExceedsReservedError" (LitTuple [LitInt reserved_sku; LitString sku; LitString order; LitInt quantity]) /\ ups = [].

Definition gen_table (f : string) : option fun_entry :=
  if String.eqb f "release" then Some (FunSpecS gen_pre gen_post)
  else if String.eqb f "release_exc0" then
  Some (FunSpecS gen_exc0_pre gen_exc0_post)
  else None.

Lemma gen_table_total_pure : forall f pre post vs,
  gen_table f = Some (FunSpec pre post) ->
  pre vs -> exists v, post vs v.
Proof.
  intros f pre post vs Hgen Hpre.
  unfold gen_table in Hgen.
  destruct (String.eqb f "release") eqn:Erel.
  - discriminate.
  - destruct (String.eqb f "release_exc0") eqn:Eexc.
    + discriminate.
    + discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma gen_table_total : forall f pre post vs sigma,
  gen_table f = Some (FunSpecS pre post) ->
  pre sigma vs ->
  exists r ups, post sigma vs r ups /\ updates_dom_in sigma ups.
Proof.
  intros f pre post vs sigma Hgen Hpre.
  unfold gen_table in Hgen.
  destruct (String.eqb f "release") eqn:Erel.
  - injection Hgen as ? ?; subst. unfold gen_pre in Hpre.
    destruct Hpre as [sku [order [quantity [store_d [on_hand_sku [reserved_sku [reorder_point_sku [Hvs [Hsigma [Hlookup [Hpos Hres]]]]]]]]]]].
    subst vs.
    exists (RVal (LitInt reserved_sku)), [(store_loc, LitDict (dict_insert_str sku (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku - quantity) (reorder_point_sku)) store_d))].
    split.
    + unfold gen_post.
      exists sku, order, quantity, store_d, on_hand_sku, reserved_sku, reorder_point_sku.
      split; [reflexivity|].
      split; [assumption|].
      split; [assumption|].
      split; [reflexivity|].
      reflexivity.
    + unfold updates_dom_in.
      intros l Hl. destruct Hl as [Hl|Hl]; [subst l; left; reflexivity| inversion Hl].
Qed.

Lemma gen_preserves_inv_0 : forall sku quantity store_d on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku,
  dict_lookup_str sku store_d = Some (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku)) ->
  row_inv (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku)) ->
  (quantity > 0)%Z ->
  (reserved_sku - quantity >= 0)%Z ->
  store_inv store_d ->
  store_inv (dict_insert_str sku (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku - quantity) (reorder_point_sku)) store_d).
Proof.
  intros sku quantity store_d on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku Hlookup Hinv_row Hpos Hsub Hstore.
  induction store_d as [| [k' v'] store_d' IH].
  - simpl. exact I.
  - simpl in *.
    destruct Hstore as [Hrow_inv Hstore_rest].
    simpl.
    destruct (String.eqb k' sku) eqn:Ek.
    + apply String.eqb_eq in Ek. subst k'.
      rewrite dict_lookup_str_eq in Hlookup.
      injection Hlookup as Hrow_eq. subst v'.
      unfold row_inv.
      unfold row_inv in Hinv_row.
      destruct Hinv_row as [on_hand [reserved [reorder_point [Hrow_eq' [Hon_pos [Hres_pos Hle]]]]]].
      injection Hrow_eq' as ? ? ?; subst on_hand reserved reorder_point.
      exists on_hand_sku, (reserved_sku - quantity), reorder_point_sku.
      split; [reflexivity|].
      split; [assumption|].
      split; [lia|].
      assert (reserved_sku - quantity <= reserved_sku) by lia.
      assert (reserved_sku <= on_hand_sku) by assumption.
      lia.
    + apply IH.
      assumption.
Qed.

#[global] Instance gen_fun_ctx : FunCtx :=
  {| fun_entries := gen_table;
     fun_specs_total := gen_table_total_pure;
     fun_specsS_total := gen_table_total |}.

Lemma store_inv_lookup : forall store_d k row,
  store_inv store_d ->
  dict_lookup_str k store_d = Some row ->
  row_inv row.
Proof.
  induction store_d as [| [k' v'] store_d' IH]; intros k row Hstore Hlookup.
  - simpl in Hlookup. discriminate.
  - simpl in Hstore. destruct Hstore as [Hrow_inv Hstore_rest].
    simpl in Hlookup.
    destruct (String.eqb k' k) eqn:Ek.
    + apply String.eqb_eq in Ek. subst k'. 
      assert (v' = row) by (apply dict_lookup_str_eq_get; assumption).
      subst v'.
      assumption.
    + apply IH with (k := k) (row := row); assumption.
Qed.

(** O1: admissibility sanity — some state and args satisfy pre ∧ invariant. *)
Lemma o1_admissibility_sanity :
  exists sigma vs, gen_pre sigma vs /\ store_inv [(LitString "SKU1", (row_of (100) (10) (10)))].
Proof.
  exists ([(store_loc, LitDict [("SKU1", row_of 100 10 10)])]).
  exists [LitString "SKU1"; LitString "ORDER1"; LitInt 5].
  split.
  - unfold gen_pre.
    exists "SKU1", "ORDER1", 5, [("SKU1", row_of 100 10 10)], 100, 10, 10.
    split; [reflexivity|].
    split; [simpl; reflexivity|].
    split; [simpl; reflexivity|].
    split; [lia|].
    lia.
  - simpl.
    unfold row_inv.
    exists 100, 10, 10.
    split; [reflexivity|].
    split; [lia|].
    split; [lia|].
    lia.
Qed.

(** O2: spec consistency — totality gives a post-satisfying outcome. *)
Lemma o2_spec_consistency : forall sigma vs,
  gen_pre sigma vs ->
  exists r ups, gen_post sigma vs r ups /\ updates_dom_in sigma ups.
Proof.
  intros sigma vs Hpre.
  destruct Hpre as [sku [order [quantity [store_d [on_hand_sku [reserved_sku [reorder_point_sku [Hvs [Hsigma [Hlookup [Hpos Hres]]]]]]]]]]].
  subst vs.
  exists (RVal (LitInt reserved_sku)), [(store_loc, LitDict (dict_insert_str sku (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku - quantity) (reorder_point_sku)) store_d))].
  split.
  - unfold gen_post.
    exists sku, order, quantity, store_d, on_hand_sku, reserved_sku, reorder_point_sku.
    split; [reflexivity|].
    split; [assumption|].
    split; [assumption|].
    split; [reflexivity|].
    reflexivity.
  - unfold updates_dom_in.
    intros l [Hl|Hl]; [subst l; left; reflexivity| inversion Hl].
Qed.

(** O3.0: exception consistency — the ReleaseExceedsReservedError arm is satisfiable. *)
Lemma o3_0_exception_consistency : forall sigma vs,
  gen_exc0_pre sigma vs ->
  exists r ups, gen_exc0_post sigma vs r ups /\ updates_dom_in sigma ups.
Proof.
  intros sigma vs Hpre.
  destruct Hpre as [sku [order [quantity [store_d [on_hand_sku [reserved_sku [reorder_point_sku [Hvs [Hsigma [Hlookup Hlt]]]]]]]]]].
  subst vs.
  exists (RExn "ReleaseExceedsReservedError" (LitTuple [LitInt reserved_sku; LitString sku; LitString order; LitInt quantity])), [].
  split.
  - unfold gen_exc0_post.
    exists sku, order, quantity, store_d, on_hand_sku, reserved_sku, reorder_point_sku.
    split; [reflexivity|].
    split; [assumption|].
    split; [assumption|].
    split; [reflexivity|].
    reflexivity.
  - unfold updates_dom_in.
    intros l Hl. destruct Hl; inversion H.
Qed.

(** O4: exit coverage — availability and the exit conditions partition. *)
Lemma o4_exit_coverage : forall (on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku quantity : Z) ( sku : string),
  (((reserved_sku >= quantity)%Z)) \/ (((reserved_sku < quantity)%Z)).
Proof. intros. lia. Qed.

(** O5: invariant preservation across the nested delta updates. *)
Lemma o5_invariant_preservation : forall (sku order : string) (quantity : Z) (store_d : list (sn_val * sn_val)) (on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku : Z),
  ((quantity > 0)%Z) ->
  (((reserved_sku >= quantity)%Z)) ->
  dict_lookup_str sku store_d = Some (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku)) ->
  store_inv store_d ->
  store_inv (dict_insert_str sku (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku - quantity) (reorder_point_sku)) store_d).
Proof.
  intros sku order quantity store_d on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku Hpos Hres Hlookup Hstore.
  apply store_inv_lookup with (k := sku) (row := row_of on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku) in Hstore; [| assumption].
  unfold row_inv in Hstore.
  destruct Hstore as [on_hand [reserved [reorder_point [Hrow_eq [Hon_pos [Hres_pos Hle]]]]]].
  injection Hrow_eq as ? ? ?; subst on_hand reserved reorder_point.
  assert (Hsub : reserved_sku - quantity >= 0)%Z by lia.
  apply gen_preserves_inv_0 with (store_d := store_d) (on_hand_sku := on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku := reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku := reorder_point_sku); assumption.
Qed.

(** O8: frame soundness — everything outside the declared frame is
    unchanged.  The generated footprint is the single store cell; every
    other location (including the trace cell) is preserved. *)
Lemma o8_frame_soundness : forall sigma vs r ups,
  gen_post sigma vs r ups ->
  forall l, l <> store_loc ->
    (apply_updates sigma ups) !! l = sigma !! l.
Proof.
  intros sigma vs r ups Hpost l Hneq.
  destruct Hpost as [sku [order [quantity [store_d [on_hand_sku [reserved_sku [reorder_point_sku [Hvs [Hsigma [Hlookup [Hr Hups]]]]]]]]]]].
  subst vs r ups.
  simpl.
  rewrite apply_updates_single_store.
  destruct (decide (store_loc = l)) as [Heq|Hneq'].
  - exfalso. apply Hneq. symmetry. assumption.
  - rewrite lookup_insert_ne; [reflexivity|assumption].
Qed.

End gen_release.

From iris.proofmode Require Import proofmode.
From iris.base_logic.lib Require Import gen_heap.
Require Import AxiomanderLang AxiomanderWp.

(** Shared prelude for generated obligations: LitDict helpers.

    Generated files Require Import this; the helpers and their lemmas
    are proven once here instead of re-emitted per contract. *)

Section spec_prelude.
Context `{FC : FunCtx}.

Fixpoint dict_lookup_str (k : string) (kvs : list (sn_val * sn_val))
    : option sn_val :=
  match kvs with
  | [] => None
  | (LitString k', v) :: rest =>
      if String.eqb k k' then Some v else dict_lookup_str k rest
  | _ :: rest => dict_lookup_str k rest
  end.

Fixpoint dict_insert_str (k : string) (v : sn_val)
    (kvs : list (sn_val * sn_val)) : list (sn_val * sn_val) :=
  match kvs with
  | [] => [(LitString k, v)]
  | (LitString k', v') :: rest =>
      if String.eqb k k' then (LitString k, v) :: rest
      else (LitString k', v') :: dict_insert_str k v rest
  | kv :: rest => kv :: dict_insert_str k v rest
  end.

Lemma dict_lookup_insert_eq : forall kvs k v,
  dict_lookup_str k (dict_insert_str k v kvs) = Some v.
Proof.
Admitted.

Lemma dict_lookup_insert_ne : forall kvs k k' v,
  k <> k' ->
  dict_lookup_str k (dict_insert_str k' v kvs) = dict_lookup_str k kvs.
Proof.
Admitted.

End spec_prelude.

(** GENERATED FILE — proof obligations for [release].

    Source contract: examples.inventory.contract:release_contract
    Generator: specsaver.lower (v2).  Do not edit by hand.

    Shape: multi-delta over keyed rows, N exception arms, typed fields.
    Deferred (v2, trace emission): state.gauge_log, state.release_log *)

From iris.proofmode Require Import proofmode.
From iris.base_logic.lib Require Import gen_heap.
Require Import AxiomanderLang AxiomanderWp.
Require Import AxiomanderPrelude.

Section gen_release.
Context `{FC : FunCtx}.

Definition store_loc : loc := Loc 1%positive.
Definition trace_loc : loc := Loc 2%positive.


Definition row_of (on_hand reserved reorder_point : Z) : sn_val :=
  LitDict [(LitString "on_hand", LitInt on_hand);
           (LitString "reserved", LitInt reserved);
           (LitString "reorder_point", LitInt reorder_point)].

Definition row_inv (v : sn_val) : Prop :=
  exists on_hand reserved reorder_point,
    v = (row_of (on_hand) (reserved) (reorder_point)) /\ (on_hand >= 0)%Z /\ (reserved >= 0)%Z /\ (reserved <= on_hand)%Z.

Fixpoint store_inv (kvs : list (sn_val * sn_val)) : Prop :=
  match kvs with
  | [] => True
  | (_, v) :: rest => row_inv v /\ store_inv rest
  end.

Definition gen_pre (sigma : sn_state) (vs : list sn_val) : Prop :=
  exists sku order quantity store_d on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku,
    vs = [LitString sku; LitString order; LitInt quantity] /\
    sigma !! store_loc = Some (LitDict store_d) /\
    dict_lookup_str sku store_d = Some (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku)) /\
    (quantity > 0)%Z /\ (((reserved_sku >= quantity)%Z)).

Definition gen_post (sigma : sn_state) (vs : list sn_val)
    (r : Result) (ups : cell_updates) : Prop :=
  exists sku order quantity store_d on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku,
    vs = [LitString sku; LitString order; LitInt quantity] /\
    sigma !! store_loc = Some (LitDict store_d) /\
    dict_lookup_str sku store_d = Some (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku)) /\
    r = RVal (LitInt reserved_sku) /\
    ups = [(store_loc, LitDict (dict_insert_str sku (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku - quantity) (reorder_point_sku)) store_d))].

Definition gen_exc0_pre (sigma : sn_state) (vs : list sn_val) : Prop :=
  exists sku order quantity store_d on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku,
    vs = [LitString sku; LitString order; LitInt quantity] /\
    sigma !! store_loc = Some (LitDict store_d) /\
    dict_lookup_str sku store_d = Some (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku)) /\
    (reserved_sku < quantity)%Z.

Definition gen_exc0_post (sigma : sn_state) (vs : list sn_val)
    (r : Result) (ups : cell_updates) : Prop :=
  exists sku order quantity store_d on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku,
    vs = [LitString sku; LitString order; LitInt quantity] /\
    sigma !! store_loc = Some (LitDict store_d) /\
    dict_lookup_str sku store_d = Some (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku)) /\
    r = RExn "ReleaseExceedsReservedError" (LitTuple [LitInt reserved_sku; LitString sku; LitString order; LitInt quantity]) /\ ups = [].

Definition gen_table (f : string) : option fun_entry :=
  if String.eqb f "release" then Some (FunSpecS gen_pre gen_post)
  else if String.eqb f "release_exc0" then
  Some (FunSpecS gen_exc0_pre gen_exc0_post)
  else None.

Lemma gen_table_total_pure : forall f pre post vs,
  gen_table f = Some (FunSpec pre post) ->
  pre vs -> exists v, post vs v.
Proof.
  intros f pre post vs Hgen Hpre.
  unfold gen_table in Hgen.
  destruct (String.eqb f "release") eqn:Erel.
  - discriminate.
  - destruct (String.eqb f "release_exc0") eqn:Eexc.
    + discriminate.
    + discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma gen_table_total : forall f pre post vs sigma,
  gen_table f = Some (FunSpecS pre post) ->
  pre sigma vs ->
  exists r ups, post sigma vs r ups /\ updates_dom_in sigma ups.
Proof.
  intros f pre post vs sigma Hgen Hpre.
  unfold gen_table in Hgen.
  destruct (String.eqb f "release") eqn:Erel.
  - injection Hgen as ? ?; subst.
    destruct (String.eqb f "release_exc0") eqn:Eexc.
    + discriminate.
    + unfold pre, post in *.
      destruct Hpre as [sku [order [quantity [store_d [on_hand_sku [reserved_sku [reorder_point_sku [Hvs [Hsigma [Hlookup [Hpos Hres]]]]]]]]]]].
      subst vs.
      exists (RVal (LitInt reserved_sku)), [(store_loc, LitDict (dict_insert_str sku (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku - quantity) (reorder_point_sku)) store_d))].
      split.
      * unfold gen_post.
        exists sku, order, quantity, store_d, on_hand_sku, reserved_sku, reorder_point_sku.
        split; [reflexivity|].
        split; [assumption|].
        split; [assumption|].
        split; [reflexivity|].
        reflexivity.
      * unfold updates_dom_in.
        apply Forall_cons. { apply is_Some_Some. exists (LitDict store_d). assumption. }
        apply Forall_nil.
  - destruct (String.eqb f "release_exc0") eqn:Eexc.
    + injection Hgen as ? ?; subst.
      unfold pre, post in *.
      destruct Hpre as [sku [order [quantity [store_d [on_hand_sku [reserved_sku [reorder_point_sku [Hvs [Hsigma [Hlookup Hlt]]]]]]]]]].
      subst vs.
      exists (RExn "ReleaseExceedsReservedError" (LitTuple [LitInt reserved_sku; LitString sku; LitString order; LitInt quantity])), [].
      split.
      * unfold gen_exc0_post.
        exists sku, order, quantity, store_d, on_hand_sku, reserved_sku, reorder_point_sku.
        split; [reflexivity|].
        split; [assumption|].
        split; [assumption|].
        split; [reflexivity|].
        reflexivity.
      * unfold updates_dom_in. apply Forall_nil.
    + discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma gen_preserves_inv_0 : forall sku quantity store_d on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku,
  dict_lookup_str sku store_d = Some (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku)) ->
  row_inv (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku)) ->
  (quantity > 0)%Z ->
  (reserved_sku - quantity >= 0)%Z ->
  store_inv store_d ->
  store_inv (dict_insert_str sku (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku - quantity) (reorder_point_sku)) store_d).
Proof.
  induction store_d as [| [k v] store_d' IH]; intros Hlookup Hinv_row Hpos Hsub Hstore.
  - simpl in Hlookup. discriminate.
  - destruct k; simpl in *.
    + destruct Hstore as [Hrow_inv Hstore_rest].
      destruct (String.eqb s sku) eqn:E.
      * apply String.eqb_eq in E; subst s.
        simpl in Hlookup.
        rewrite String.eqb_refl in Hlookup.
        inversion Hlookup; subst v.
        simpl.
        unfold row_inv.
        unfold row_inv in Hinv_row.
        destruct Hinv_row as [on_hand [reserved [reorder_point [Hrow_eq [Hon_pos [Hres_pos Hle]]]]]].
        injection Hrow_eq as ? ? ?; subst on_hand reserved reorder_point.
        exists on_hand_sku, (reserved_sku - quantity), reorder_point_sku.
        split; [reflexivity|].
        split; [assumption|].
        split; [lia|].
        split.
        -- assert (reserved_sku <= on_hand_sku) by assumption.
           assert (reserved_sku - quantity <= reserved_sku) by lia.
           lia.
        -- apply IH; assumption.
      * apply IH; assumption.
    + destruct Hstore as [Hrow_inv Hstore_rest].
      apply IH; assumption.
    + destruct Hstore as [Hrow_inv Hstore_rest].
      apply IH; assumption.
    + destruct Hstore as [Hrow_inv Hstore_rest].
      apply IH; assumption.
    + destruct Hstore as [Hrow_inv Hstore_rest].
      apply IH; assumption.
    + destruct Hstore as [Hrow_inv Hstore_rest].
      apply IH; assumption.
    + destruct Hstore as [Hrow_inv Hstore_rest].
      apply IH; assumption.
    + destruct Hstore as [Hrow_inv Hstore_rest].
      apply IH; assumption.
    + destruct Hstore as [Hrow_inv Hstore_rest].
      apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

#[global] Instance gen_fun_ctx : FunCtx :=
  {| fun_entries := gen_table;
     fun_specs_total := gen_table_total_pure;
     fun_specsS_total := gen_table_total |}.

Lemma store_inv_lookup : forall store_d k row,
  store_inv store_d ->
  dict_lookup_str k store_d = Some row ->
  row_inv row.
Proof.
  induction store_d as [| [k' v'] store_d' IH]; intros k row Hstore Hlookup.
  - simpl in Hlookup. discriminate.
  - destruct k'; simpl in *.
    + destruct Hstore as [Hrow_inv Hstore_rest].
      destruct (String.eqb s k) eqn:E.
      * apply String.eqb_eq in E; subst s.
        simpl in Hlookup.
        rewrite String.eqb_refl in Hlookup.
        inversion Hlookup; subst v'.
        assumption.
      * apply IH; assumption.
    + destruct Hstore as [Hrow_inv Hstore_rest].
      apply IH; assumption.
    + destruct Hstore as [Hrow_inv Hstore_rest].
      apply IH; assumption.
    + destruct Hstore as [Hrow_inv Hstore_rest].
      apply IH; assumption.
    + destruct Hstore as [Hrow_inv Hstore_rest].
      apply IH; assumption.
    + destruct Hstore as [Hrow_inv Hstore_rest].
      apply IH; assumption.
    + destruct Hstore as [Hrow_inv Hstore_rest].
      apply IH; assumption.
    + destruct Hstore as [Hrow_inv Hstore_rest].
      apply IH; assumption.
    + destruct Hstore as [Hrow_inv Hstore_rest].
      apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

(** O1: admissibility sanity — some state and args satisfy pre ∧ invariant. *)
Lemma o1_admissibility_sanity :
  exists sigma vs, gen_pre sigma vs /\ store_inv [(LitString "SKU1", (row_of (100) (10) (10)))].
Proof.
  exists ([(store_loc, LitDict [("SKU1", row_of 100 10 10)])]).
  exists [LitString "SKU1"; LitString "ORDER1"; LitInt 5].
  split.
  - unfold gen_pre.
    exists "SKU1", "ORDER1", 5, [("SKU1", row_of 100 10 10)], 100, 10, 10.
    split; [reflexivity|].
    split; [simpl; reflexivity|].
    split; [simpl; reflexivity|].
    split; [lia|].
    lia.
  - simpl.
    unfold row_inv.
    repeat split.
    + reflexivity.
    + lia.
    + lia.
    + lia.
Qed.

(** O2: spec consistency — totality gives a post-satisfying outcome. *)
Lemma o2_spec_consistency : forall sigma vs,
  gen_pre sigma vs ->
  exists r ups, gen_post sigma vs r ups /\ updates_dom_in sigma ups.
Proof.
  intros sigma vs Hpre.
  destruct Hpre as [sku [order [quantity [store_d [on_hand_sku [reserved_sku [reorder_point_sku [Hvs [Hsigma [Hlookup [Hpos Hres]]]]]]]]]]].
  subst vs.
  exists (RVal (LitInt reserved_sku)), [(store_loc, LitDict (dict_insert_str sku (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku - quantity) (reorder_point_sku)) store_d))].
  split.
  - unfold gen_post.
    exists sku, order, quantity, store_d, on_hand_sku, reserved_sku, reorder_point_sku.
    split; [reflexivity|].
    split; [assumption|].
    split; [assumption|].
    split; [reflexivity|].
    reflexivity.
  - unfold updates_dom_in.
    apply Forall_cons; [| apply Forall_nil].
    apply is_Some_Some. exists (LitDict store_d). assumption.
Qed.

(** O3.0: exception consistency — the ReleaseExceedsReservedError arm is satisfiable. *)
Lemma o3_0_exception_consistency : forall sigma vs,
  gen_exc0_pre sigma vs ->
  exists r ups, gen_exc0_post sigma vs r ups /\ updates_dom_in sigma ups.
Proof.
  intros sigma vs Hpre.
  destruct Hpre as [sku [order [quantity [store_d [on_hand_sku [reserved_sku [reorder_point_sku [Hvs [Hsigma [Hlookup Hlt]]]]]]]]]].
  subst vs.
  exists (RExn "ReleaseExceedsReservedError" (LitTuple [LitInt reserved_sku; LitString sku; LitString order; LitInt quantity])), [].
  split.
  - unfold gen_exc0_post.
    exists sku, order, quantity, store_d, on_hand_sku, reserved_sku, reorder_point_sku.
    split; [reflexivity|].
    split; [assumption|].
    split; [assumption|].
    split; [reflexivity|].
    reflexivity.
  - unfold updates_dom_in. apply Forall_nil.
Qed.

(** O4: exit coverage — availability and the exit conditions partition. *)
Lemma o4_exit_coverage : forall (on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku quantity : Z) ( sku : string),
  (((reserved_sku >= quantity)%Z)) \/ (((reserved_sku < quantity)%Z)).
Proof. intros. lia. Qed.

(** O5: invariant preservation across the nested delta updates. *)
Lemma o5_invariant_preservation : forall (sku order : string) (quantity : Z) (store_d : list (sn_val * sn_val)) (on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku : Z),
  ((quantity > 0)%Z) ->
  (((reserved_sku >= quantity)%Z)) ->
  dict_lookup_str sku store_d = Some (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku)) ->
  store_inv store_d ->
  store_inv (dict_insert_str sku (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku - quantity) (reorder_point_sku)) store_d).
Proof.

  unfold row_inv in Hstore.
  destruct Hstore as [on_hand [reserved [reorder_point [Hrow_eq [Hon_pos [Hres_pos Hle]]]]]].
  injection Hrow_eq as ? ? ?; subst on_hand reserved reorder_point.
  assert (Hsub : reserved_sku - quantity >= 0)%Z by lia.
  apply gen_preserves_inv_0 with (store_d := store_d) (on_hand_sku := on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku := reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku := reorder_point_sku); assumption.
Qed.

(** O8: frame soundness — everything outside the declared frame is
    unchanged.  The generated footprint is the single store cell; every
    other location (including the trace cell) is preserved. *)
Lemma o8_frame_soundness : forall sigma vs r ups,
  gen_post sigma vs r ups ->
  forall l, l <> store_loc ->
    (apply_updates sigma ups) !! l = sigma !! l.
Proof.
  intros sigma vs r ups Hpost l Hneq.
  destruct Hpost as [sku [order [quantity [store_d [on_hand_sku [reserved_sku [reorder_point_sku [Hvs [Hsigma [Hlookup [Hr Hups]]]]]]]]]]].
  subst vs r ups.
  simpl.
  rewrite lookup_insert_ne; [reflexivity|assumption].
Qed.

Require Import AxiomanderLang AxiomanderPrelude.
Require Import String List ZArith.
Import ListNotations.

Section Test.
Context `{FC : FunCtx}.

Definition row_of (on_hand reserved reorder_point : Z) : sn_val :=
  LitDict [(LitString "on_hand", LitInt on_hand);
           (LitString "reserved", LitInt reserved);
           (LitString "reorder_point", LitInt reorder_point)].

Definition row_inv (v : sn_val) : Prop :=
  exists on_hand reserved reorder_point,
    v = (row_of (on_hand) (reserved) (reorder_point)) /\ (on_hand >= 0)%Z /\ (reserved >= 0)%Z /\ (reserved <= on_hand)%Z.

Fixpoint store_inv (kvs : list (sn_val * sn_val)) : Prop :=
  match kvs with
  | [] => True
  | (_, v) :: rest => row_inv v /\ store_inv rest
  end.

Lemma gen_preserves_inv_0 : forall sku quantity store_d on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku,
  dict_lookup_str sku store_d = Some (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku)) ->
  row_inv (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku)) ->
  (quantity > 0)%Z ->
  (reserved_sku - quantity >= 0)%Z ->
  store_inv store_d ->
  store_inv (dict_insert_str sku (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku - quantity) (reorder_point_sku)) store_d).
Proof.
  induction store_d as [| [k v] store_d].
  - simpl. intros. discriminate.
  - simpl. intros on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku Hl Hinv Hpos Hsub [Hv Hs'].
    destruct k as [n|b|s|f|l| |lbl pl|vs|vs2|kvs|vs].
    + (* LitInt *)
      simpl in Hl. simpl dict_insert_str. simpl store_inv.
      split; [exact Hv|].
      eapply IHstore_d; eauto.
    + (* LitBool *)
      simpl in Hl. simpl dict_insert_str. simpl store_inv.
      split; [exact Hv|].
      eapply IHstore_d; eauto.
    + (* LitString *)
      simpl in Hl.
      simpl dict_insert_str.
      destruct (String.eqb s sku) eqn:E.
      * apply String.eqb_eq in E. subst s.
        rewrite String.eqb_refl.
        simpl store_inv.
        rewrite String.eqb_refl in Hl.
        injection Hl as ->.
        split.
        -- unfold row_inv in *. destruct Hinv as [on_h [res [reo [Hr [H1 [H2 H3]]]]]].
           injection Hr as ? ? ?. subst on_h res reo.
           exists on_hand_sku, (reserved_sku - quantity), reorder_point_sku.
           split; [reflexivity|]. split; [assumption|]. split; [lia|]. lia.
        -- eapply IHstore_d; eauto.
      * rewrite E in Hl. rewrite E. simpl store_inv.
        split; [exact Hv|].
        eapply IHstore_d; eauto.
    + (* LitFloat *)
      simpl in Hl. simpl dict_insert_str. simpl store_inv.
      split; [exact Hv|].
      eapply IHstore_d; eauto.
    + (* LitLoc *)
      simpl in Hl. simpl dict_insert_str. simpl store_inv.
      split; [exact Hv|].
      eapply IHstore_d; eauto.
    + (* LitUnit *)
      simpl in Hl. simpl dict_insert_str. simpl store_inv.
      split; [exact Hv|].
      eapply IHstore_d; eauto.
    + (* LitExn *)
      simpl in Hl. simpl dict_insert_str. simpl store_inv.
      split; [exact Hv|].
      eapply IHstore_d; eauto.
    + (* LitList *)
      simpl in Hl. simpl dict_insert_str. simpl store_inv.
      split; [exact Hv|].
      eapply IHstore_d; eauto.
    + (* LitTuple *)
      simpl in Hl. simpl dict_insert_str. simpl store_inv.
      split; [exact Hv|].
      eapply IHstore_d; eauto.
    + (* LitDict *)
      simpl in Hl. simpl dict_insert_str. simpl store_inv.
      split; [exact Hv|].
      eapply IHstore_d; eauto.
    + (* LitSet *)
      simpl in Hl. simpl dict_insert_str. simpl store_inv.
      split; [exact Hv|].
      eapply IHstore_d; eauto.
Qed.

End Test.

Require Import AxiomanderLang AxiomanderPrelude.
Require Import String List ZArith.
Import ListNotations.

Section Test.
Context `{FC : FunCtx}.

Definition row_of (on_hand reserved reorder_point : Z) : sn_val :=
  LitDict [(LitString "on_hand", LitInt on_hand);
           (LitString "reserved", LitInt reserved);
           (LitString "reorder_point", LitInt reorder_point)].

Definition row_inv (v : sn_val) : Prop :=
  exists on_hand reserved reorder_point,
    v = (row_of (on_hand) (reserved) (reorder_point)) /\ (on_hand >= 0)%Z /\ (reserved >= 0)%Z /\ (reserved <= on_hand)%Z.

Fixpoint store_inv (kvs : list (sn_val * sn_val)) : Prop :=
  match kvs with
  | [] => True
  | (_, v) :: rest => row_inv v /\ store_inv rest
  end.

Lemma gen_preserves_inv_0 : forall sku quantity store_d on_hand_sku reserved_sku reorder_point_sku,
  dict_lookup_str sku store_d = Some (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku) (reorder_point_sku)) ->

  store_inv store_d ->
  store_inv (dict_insert_str sku (row_of (on_hand_sku) (reserved_sku - quantity) (reorder_point_sku)) store_d).
Proof.
  induction store_d as [| [k v] store_d].
  - simpl. intros. discriminate.

    simpl in Hs.

    destruct k as [n|b|s|f|l| |lbl pl|vs|vs2|kvs|vs]; simpl in *.

        injection Hl as ->.

        fold dict_insert_str. fold store_inv.
        split.
        -- unfold row_inv in *. destruct Hinv as [on_h [res [reo [Hr [H1 [H2 H3]]]]]].
           injection Hr as ? ? ?. subst on_h res reo.
           exists on_hand_sku, (reserved_sku - quantity), reorder_point_sku.
           split; [reflexivity|]. split; [assumption|]. split; [lia|]. lia.
        -- eapply IHstore_d; eauto.
      * rewrite E in Hl.
        rewrite E.
        fold dict_insert_str. fold store_inv.

    + (* LitDict *)
      split; [exact Hv|].
      eapply IHstore_d; eauto.
